reason: The plugin is primarily a DeepSeek-integrated DSH web utility that shows session cost details and account balance in a popup, and it is driven by external API interaction (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY + balance lookup), so it is best classified under external services with monitoring-like cost visibility.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 dsh 网页端会话界面增加入口，展示当前会话的 DeepSeek 花费明细，并提供账户余额查询。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an entry in the DSH web session UI to display current DeepSeek session cost details and provide account balance lookup.

capabilities: reads DeepSeek API credentials from environment or local credentials config
queries external service endpoints for DeepSeek session pricing context and account balance
adds a web-session UI control to display cost and balance information
